denominator: All four fixed requests: send/usage/parse/schema failures, incorrect facts, disagreements and unknowns retained
adjudication: Original source-first seven assertions per excerpt unchanged; explicit reason and outputPointer required per fact/layer. Whole incorrect if any factual error; incomplete, disputed or unadjudicated prose UNKNOWN. Unknown personal status is distinct from missing stated facts. Exact/unknown endpoints, owners, type, materials, destination/completion, titles/descriptions/extras and scope all checked.
legalRepresentation: Allow factual equivalence and lossless ordering/naming, never wrong objects or dates. Explicit unannounced null can be correct; no default clock. Do not infer QR destination, old replacement endpoint, interest or enrollment.
decision: Report correct/incorrect/UNKNOWN for each source and layer; no paired winner or new-model improvement claim. At most two evidence roots and one later input hypothesis. Do not change references after seeing answers.
stopping: Once-send strict ordinal, zero automatic retry/repair/verifier; any send/raw/usage/settlement uncertainty seals and stops later paid units. Old sealed sites remain untouched.
